channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: What zerofi Does When an XMR Transfer Is Pending
item.description: zerofi turns XMR into a token for Ethereum, but a sent Monero payment is only the first step; confirmation, processing and minting can all take time.

item.title: How a Business Should Size a SushiSwap DCA Order
item.description: Set a fixed budget first, then choose each SushiSwap DCA trade and its timing around cash needs, fees and the risk of buying through a price move.

item.title: Aviva adds £22bn sterling fund share class to XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has launched a tokenized share class of its £22 billion sterling fund on the XRP Ledger, adding blockchain-based access while keeping the fund structure off-chain.

item.title: Aviva tokenises £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has put a tokenised share class of its £22bn sterling fund on XRP Ledger, adding an on-chain route into a money market fund for eligible investors.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's stablecoin rule keeps issuer-paid interest banned but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, shaping how crypto platforms can pay customers.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC has launched its first Hong Kong dollar stablecoin on PayMe, giving more than 3.3 million users a new way to send money and pay merchants.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing its voting system with a design targeting 150-millisecond finality and faster settlement for payments and trades.

item.title: OCC rule leaves crypto exchanges room to offer stablecoin rewards
item.description: The OCC says stablecoin issuers cannot pay holders interest, but exchanges may share earnings through rewards, leaving the key yield fight to case-by-case review.

item.title: Why a Pool’s Reserves Change the Price of Your Next Swap
item.description: A pool’s token balances set its starting price, but each swap changes those balances. Learn why reserve gaps move prices and how to read a swap quote.

item.title: SushiSwap: choose a chain before you trade
item.description: SushiSwap trades happen on a chosen blockchain, and the cost can include a swap fee and network fee. Check the quote and chain before you confirm.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin for PayMe users in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin on PayMe in Hong Kong, with wallet access due in coming days for more than 3.3 million users and payments at over 100,000 merchants.

item.title: Polygon Bridge withdrawals: how to check a stuck transfer
item.description: A stuck Polygon withdrawal may need a wallet confirmation, a retry or a manual exit; check the transaction record before signing anything again.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s new stablecoin rule leaves exchange rewards possible but subject to case-by-case review, shaping how crypto firms can pay customers from January 2027.

item.title: How to Read a Cross-Chain Swap Quote
item.description: A swap quote is an estimate, not a promise: compare the amount you will receive, the fees around the trade and the protection against price changes.

item.title: How Apps Should Quote BaseSwap Trades
item.description: Apps should quote a BaseSwap trade from live pool data for the exact token pair and amount, then show fees, minimum output and how quickly the estimate can go stale.

item.title: Solana switches mainnet to Alpenglow at slot 459,653,000
item.description: Solana switched mainnet to Alpenglow at slot 459,653,000, replacing TowerBFT with a voting system designed to make transactions final in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Dogecoin Labs joins wallet, app and payment teams
item.description: Dogecoin Labs is bringing MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App under one organization, linking a wallet, app network and merchant tools as it seeks more ways to use DOGE.

item.title: How developers choose wallet network settings with chainslist
item.description: Chainslist shows why developers must match a wallet’s chain ID, RPC endpoint and display details, and how to check that a network entry reaches the intended chain.

item.title: Blast bridge: seven steps to withdraw ETH to Ethereum
item.description: Blast withdrawals now take about one day, but ETH must still be proved and claimed on Ethereum. Here are the seven steps, plus the gas and token details.

item.title: Visa and Mesh link crypto wallets to 175 million merchants
item.description: Visa and Mesh plan to let people pay from crypto and stablecoin balances at 175 million merchant locations, using participating wallets without a separate card.
